title: Use Explore to query data without building a dashboard

blocks.content: Dashboards are saved pages someone already built. When you want to look at the data directly, Grafana Cloud has a page for that: Explore. Pick a data source, run a query, read the chart. Nothing to save, nothing to build — adjust the query and run it again until you see what you need. On Grafana Play it opens with a working sample query, so you can see the shape of the page before you write one of your own.
Click **Explore** in the main menu. On Play it opens with a working sample query.
That's Explore: one page for looking at your data directly. Nothing saved, nothing built.
Next, read the page from top to bottom:
The **data source** picker chooses where the query runs: a connection to a place that already holds your data.
blocks.tooltip: Every query runs against one of your connected data stores. This picker chooses which one.

blocks.content: Click **Run query** to run the query again.
blocks.tooltip: Sends the query on this page to the data source and redraws the result below.

blocks.content: The result comes back drawn as a chart. Change the query, run it again, and the picture changes with it.
blocks.tooltip: This is the result of the query above it, drawn the same way a dashboard panel would draw it.

blocks.content: Pick a data source, run a query, read the chart. That's Explore: a scratch pad for your data, no dashboard required.
